correctness.rationale: The exact SQN formulation reduces at length five to two one-variable quadratic branches. Their endpoint and vertex bounds prove the all-q upper bound, equality conditions force the stated constructions, the lone q=7 comparison is exact, and finite SQN checks corroborate the derivation.

originality.rationale: The closest literature proves exact formulas only through length four and reports finite SQN computations at length five and above. Searches across standard synonyms and formula variants did not locate the all-q length-five formula, sharp q=4 structural threshold, or exact maximum-code count. Originality is to the best of our knowledge with an explicit terminology risk.

value.rationale: The theorem settles the first length beyond the known exact length-four case, proves Blackburn's fixed-length construction conjecture at n=5 from q=4 onward, classifies all maxima for q>=4, and gives N(q,5) exactly.
